campaign.title: Hard-M1 t=1 high-height inverse-residue Fourier gate

resource_policy.computation_policy: Exact computation may test finite inverse-residue identities, parity, multiplicity, and adversarial deletion patterns only. It is diagnostic_only and cannot certify an asymptotic estimate.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact one-sided dyadic high-height tangent-gcd aggregate be bounded by L^2 X^epsilon through a genuinely joint inverse-residue Fourier mechanism, can a strict target-safe zero/low-frequency or nonresonant sector be proved with an exact centered complement, or does literal arithmetic deletion force an exact capacity or self-return obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: For every fixed B>0, every real X>=2, every literal middle or lower residual hard-M1 shell L>=2, sigma in {+1,-1}, and every nonempty dyadic Y<h<=2Y with Y>H_B=floor((log(2X))^B), prove the one-sided inequality Re sum_(omega in {+,-}) sum_(f=(kappa,g,h,U,v) satisfying K185.27, Y<h<=2Y) (-1)^(S_(0,omega)) sum_(t in I_(f,omega)) (-1)^t B_(f,omega)^sigma(t) <<_(B,epsilon) L^2 X^epsilon, with all quantities exactly K185.27 and K185.30--K185.35.
quantities: There is one outer real part over both orientations, every primitive row, every affine index, and every literal endpoint field; the theorem is one-sided and no lower bound for a negative dyadic real part is required.
The invariant domain is kappa,g,h,U,v>0, kappa,g,U odd, (gU,v)=1, (U,h)=1, and 0<2 kappa g h<R_0=ceil(L), with the separate U=1 anchor convention retained.

For U>1 the exact anchor is E_U(+bar(v)h) in the plus orientation and E_U(-bar(v)h) in the minus orientation, where E_U(a)=(-1)^[a]_U and E_U(a)=U^(-1) sum_(k mod U) hat(E)_U(k)e(ka/U), hat(E)_U(k)=2/(1+e(-k/U)).

The fresh mechanism must retain the centered nonzero Fourier modes jointly over h, v, t, both orientations, selectors, deletions, endpoints, and phases before any positive norm. Splitting off a target-safe zero mode is not itself a proof of the complement.

Positive capacity is O(Y L^2 X^epsilon) and the target is O(L^2 X^epsilon), so the full factor Y must be recovered before any positive row, orientation, frequency, gcd, selector, or endpoint recombination.

A strict sector must carry an exact complementary signed aggregate. Even complete success closes only the exact original-t=1 residual after accepted connectors; every original t>=2 small-G incidence and the large-G near-resonant complement remain open.

completion_criteria: Derive the exact inverse-residue anchor and Fourier normalization for U>1 and reconcile the separate U=1 convention without changing the canonical multiplicity-one carrier.
Price the zero mode, every proposed low-frequency or nonresonant packet, and its exact centered complement at restored L, Y, kappa, g, U, and X powers.

Attempt the complete one-sided target with the literal selectors, squarefree and coprimality deletions, profiles, floors, stars, hard samples, crossings, endpoints, phases, and zero extensions retained.
Identify precisely how the mechanism uses the actual Vaaler/chi_4 coefficient and why it does not prove the unsigned or adversarial analogue.
Receive an independent statement-only derivation of the high-height carrier, its target/capacity gap, and either a proof kernel or the first unavoidable obstruction.
Review normalization, multiplicity, literal deletion, power bookkeeping, one-sided real-part placement, and downstream owner scope before any promotion.
Apply no graph change without a mechanically valid State Patch, independent reverse/replay audit, and green lifecycle validation.
Close under exactly one declared exit label and do not pivot in-round to another owner.

review_seams.requirement: Verify the U>1 Fourier coefficients, U=1 convention, both anchor signs, primitive domain, affine index sets, and multiplicity one.
Verify that selectors, squarefree and coprimality masks, all profiles, floors, stars, hard values, crossings, endpoints, signs, phases, and zero extensions remain literal.
Verify every L, Y, kappa, g, U, and X power, the full factor-Y requirement, and the single one-sided outer real part.
Verify that no gain comes from bare alternation, positive frequency/orientation recombination, alias energy, conductor centering, or an arbitrary-coefficient theorem.
Reconcile the statement-only result with the literal kernel and quarantine every t>=2, near-resonant, parent, bridge, theorem, and exponent claim.

closing_assessment.main_result: The exact inverse-residue Fourier decomposition proves a strict target-safe packet containing all U=1 rows, every exact conductor q<=H_B, all remaining modes with U<=4H_B, and all remaining ordinary edge modes 0<|k|_U<=H_B. The exact joint complement U>4H_B, q_U(k)>H_B, |k|_U>H_B retains positive capacity YL^2X^epsilon and its one-sided L^2X^epsilon estimate remains open. No complete high-h relation, t=1 residual, parent, bridge, theorem, or exponent changes.
